Definition: to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to meet, come or be in front, confront, go before; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to meet, confront, come to meet, receive; 1a2) to go before, go in front, be in front; 1a3) to lead, be beforehand, anticipate, forestall; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to come in front; 1b2) to confront, anticipate
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
